# TapTile — Pakistan's 1st Digital Receipt Network (Full Context)

> TapTile is Pakistan's first zero-POS-change digital receipt infrastructure. It connects seamlessly with retail counter setups, delivers instant digital receipts via NFC or QR to customers' smartphones, automates FBR fiscal compliance, and eliminates thermal paper roll costs by up to 85% — all without modifying existing billing software.

---

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Does TapTile require changes to POS software?**
No. TapTile installs alongside existing systems — your printer keeps working exactly as before. It operates independently without touching your billing software. If TapTile ever goes offline, paper receipts continue uninterrupted. Zero risk to existing operations.

**Do customers need to install an app?**
No app, no account, no signup. The receipt opens instantly in the customer's native mobile browser the moment they tap (NFC) or scan (QR). Any NFC-enabled smartphone — Android or iPhone — works out of the box.

**What happens if internet is down?**
The TapTile counter device works fully offline. Customers can still tap or scan and receive their receipt instantly. Everything syncs automatically to the cloud when connectivity is restored.

**How fast can a store go live?**
Most stores are fully live in under 48 hours. Setup is handled remotely — no store downtime, no technician visit required for most POS setups.

**Is TapTile FBR compliant?**
Yes. TapTile is fully compliant with FBR Tier-1 retailer fiscalization requirements. The system automatically formats receipt records, generates verifiable FBR invoice credentials, and securely transmits sales transactions to FBR in real time.

---

## Technical Overview

### Counter Device & Hardware
- Compatibility: Universal printer and POS terminal support
- Power: Efficient counter-powered setup
- Continuity: Built-in failover ensures uninterrupted paper receipt printing

### Software & Delivery
- Receipt delivery: Instant NFC tap or high-density dynamic QR code
- Delivery time: Under 2 seconds from checkout completion
- Architecture: Cloud-synced infrastructure with offline-first counter resilience

### Compliance & Security
- FBR integration: Tier-1 fiscalization support with verifiable QR codes
- Data retention: 7-year electronic invoice archive per FBR regulations
- Security: End-to-end encrypted HTTPS transmission

TapTile offers simple, transparent pricing for retail stores with zero upfront software overhaul costs. A free pilot is available for qualifying retailers. Contact contact@taptile.pk for multi-branch and enterprise chains.

## Competitive Differentiation

Unlike SMS-based receipt services (which require phone number capture) or email receipts (which require account creation), TapTile delivers receipts via NFC tap or QR scan with zero customer friction and zero merchant software changes. It connects smoothly with existing printer setups, making it compatible with any POS system in Pakistani retail.
